desc: Ideation: choose remainder-frequency DP as the primary approach.
Implement `countSubstrings` with an integer answer and `freq[d]` for d=1..9, updating all remainders for each new digit and adding the one-character substring.
Add the current digit's valid count only when x != 0 by adding `new_freq[x][0]`, while still carrying zero-ending substrings forward for future extensions.
Test edge cases including all zeros, single digit, leading zeros, random small brute-force comparisons, and length 1e5 to verify O(n) behavior and correct counts.
